propositions: Operators running gate operations through an OpenAI-compatible gateway receive no request metadata, preventing attribution and tracing of LLM calls to rebar execution contexts
rebar reserves but never populates the trace_id field in review result and completion verdict schemas, leaving it null at every emission site

Configurable request headers with variable interpolation (environment and per-run values) must be delivered through pydantic-ai's ModelSettings.extra_headers without hardcoding vendor-specific header names
Correlation identifiers must be read from active OpenTelemetry spans when recording, or minted at gate run boundaries, and propagated consistently across all LLM calls within a single gate run
Credential-bearing headers must be validated and redacted from logs, diagnostics, and provider provenance records to prevent accidental exposure in verdicts and sidecars
